name: Warden of Renewal
descr: Play the Warden of Renewal if you want to use powerful magic to heal your party.

foundations.name: Clarity of Nature
foundations.text: Once per long rest, you can create a space of natural serenity within Close range. When you spend a few minutes resting within the space, clear Stress equal to your Instinct, distributed as you choose between you and your allies.

foundations.name: Regeneration
foundations.text: Touch a creature and **spend 3 Hope.** That creature clears **1d4** Hit Points.

specializations.name: Regenerative Reach
specializations.text: You can target creatures within Very Close range with your "Regeneration" feature.

specializations.name: Warden's Protection
specializations.text: Once per long rest, **spend 2 Hope** to clear 2 Hit Points on **1d4** allies within Close range.

masteries.name: Defender
masteries.text: Your animal transformation embodies a healing guardian spirit. When you're in Beastform and an ally within Close range marks 2 or more Hit Points, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by 1.
